player_prompt.intro:
Nang {player_id} mi wa ai. Nang Guess The Number hkying sai.
{min_number} na {max_number} kaw na shi hkying re ai hte {max_turns} hkying shi hkying re ai.
Nang nan hkying kam ai shaloi, ga shadang 'hkying kaja' hte 'hkying hkra' nanhte hkying sai.
Nang nan hkying jaw ai gaw shanhte hkying sha ai. [5] hkying kaja nanhte hkying sai.
Nang hkying hkying ai shaloi, nan hkying jaw ai hte maren hkying sai. Nanhte hkying sai jaw ai gaw shi hkying re sai hte hkying hkra sai.
Nang nan hkying jaw ai.
